prometheus_stopped.body:
# HELP sunrise_up 1 while the game runs and answers
# TYPE sunrise_up gauge
sunrise_up 0
# HELP sunrise_supervisor_uptime_seconds Seconds since sunrise-server started
# TYPE sunrise_supervisor_uptime_seconds gauge
sunrise_supervisor_uptime_seconds <dynamic>
# HELP sunrise_crashes Game crashes since sunrise-server started
# TYPE sunrise_crashes gauge
sunrise_crashes 2
# HELP sunrise_tps Ticks per second over the last 5 seconds
# TYPE sunrise_tps gauge
sunrise_tps 19.9
# HELP sunrise_tps_target The tick rate the game aims for (/tick rate)
# TYPE sunrise_tps_target gauge
sunrise_tps_target 20
# HELP sunrise_mspt Milliseconds per tick: the average and the percentiles /tick query reports
# TYPE sunrise_mspt gauge
sunrise_mspt{stat="average"} 8.25
sunrise_mspt{stat="p50"} 7
sunrise_mspt{stat="p95"} 12.5
sunrise_mspt{stat="p99"} 18
# HELP sunrise_players_online Players online
# TYPE sunrise_players_online gauge
sunrise_players_online 2
# HELP sunrise_players_max max-players
# TYPE sunrise_players_max gauge
sunrise_players_max 20
# HELP sunrise_chunks_loaded Chunks loaded
# TYPE sunrise_chunks_loaded gauge
sunrise_chunks_loaded 321
# HELP sunrise_memory_rss_bytes The game process's resident memory
# TYPE sunrise_memory_rss_bytes gauge
sunrise_memory_rss_bytes 536870912
# HELP sunrise_cpu_percent The game process's CPU use (100 = one core)
# TYPE sunrise_cpu_percent gauge
sunrise_cpu_percent 12.5
